title: Elastic Co. — Incident Overview
description: Orchestrator errors, OOMKilled events, pod memory, and slow DB spans for the acme-retail checkout incident.

config.content:
## Elastic Co. incident overview
Tenant **acme-retail** · DAG `fulfillment.checkout` · checkout-api **v2.4.1** · cluster `eks-elastic-prod-usc1` · filter `labels.demo: elastic-co`. Set time to **Last 6 hours**.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-elasticco.orchestrator-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE log.level == "error"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elasticco.orchestrator-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE log.level == "warning"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elasticco.k8s.event-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE kubernetes.event.reason == "OOMKilled"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE span.type == "db" AND span.subtype == "postgresql"
| WHERE span.duration.us > 2000000
| STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elasticco.orchestrator-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), log.level

FROM logs-elasticco.orchestrator-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "warning")
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY tenant.id
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM metrics-elasticco.k8s.pod-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE service.name == "checkout-api"
| STATS rss_mib = AVG(kubernetes.pod.memory.usage.bytes) / 1024 / 1024 BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM metrics-elasticco.k8s.pod-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE service.name == "checkout-api"
| STATS restarts = MAX(kubernetes.pod.restart.count) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), kubernetes.pod.name

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart
| WHERE labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE span.type == "db" AND span.subtype == "postgresql"
| WHERE span.duration.us > 2000000
| STATS count = COUNT(*), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000 BY tenant.id
| SORT count DESC
